items.text: Under the Oregon Psilocybin Services Act, adults 21 and over can use psilocybin at a licensed service center without a prescription or referral, after a preparation session with a licensed facilitator. Products can't be bought to take away; it isn't a dispensary model.

sources.title: Psilocybin 101: what to know about Oregon's psilocybin services
sources.supports: access rules for Oregon Psilocybin Services

psychoactive-substances.notes: Confirm with the place's own law before relying on it.
